description: Check every stored API key and report which are healthy, expiring soon, over their usage budget, or flagged by the security score. Use this for a vault-wide status sweep; use prophetkey_get_key_info for a single key. May contact provider APIs to validate keys, so it can be slower than the other tools. Read-only: it never modifies, rotates, or deletes keys.
name: prophetkey_health_check
title: Check key health
